subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule tech deep-dive / meeting invite issues
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule tech deep-dive / meeting invite issues

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You’re evaluating high-throughput inference for customer-facing chat and embeddings (approx 100k monthly active users; strict uptime and audit requirements).
- Key success criteria: sub-200ms p95 latency, SOC2 + KMS support, and predictable unit cost.
- Next step: technical deep-dive + demo to validate throughput and integration approach (we’ll bring eng + infra).

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 23 Jun, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 24 Jun, 14:00–15:00

I’ve attached a short demo agenda and the security questionnaire for your infra team to scan through. I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm which slot works — please also let me know if your calendar didn’t receive the invite (we’ve seen occasional timezone/URL issues with some provider integrations).

If neither slot works, share two windows that suit you and we’ll align.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page, agenda), acme-security-questions.xlsx (xlsx, 12 rows)

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule tech deep-dive / meeting invite issues

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the recap and the agenda — the attachments look useful. Quick note: we did not receive the calendar invite you mentioned. Also, when I tried to create a tentative block I saw the default timezone (in the stub invite) set to GMT instead of PDT — not sure if that’s from your calendar system.

Our availability next week (PDT): Tue 23 Jun 09:30–11:30 or Wed 24 Jun 13:30–15:30. Either would work for us.

Can you resend the invite explicitly in Pacific Time and include the technical attendees from our side (I’ll add Tom on infra).

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform Product
Acme Corp

- Join: https://redwood.app/meet/jw-ACME-0618 (new link)
- Dial-in: +1 (415) 555-0199 PIN 7231
